summary: Former Flathead National Forest tower 9 miles NNE of Whitefish, Montana: a 1935 30-foot pole L-4 tower, destroyed in 1977; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1977; no source describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: 30-foot pole L-4 tower, on a southeast spur half a mile below the summit

notes_for_editor: Both sources agree the tower is gone. The 1977 destruction date comes from firelookout.com only; the FFLA list gives no year. height_m is converted from the 30 ft pole figure (9.1 m); the page does not say whether that is height to the cab floor. elevation_m is null in the record; the page gives 6,650 ft (about 2027 m). montanalookouts.weebly.com Flathead County page lists the site with a survey location only; not used.
